text:
ops-bot: Pager: increased 5xx and P95 latency on inference-rope-prod cluster in us-west-2. Alert: kv-cache-eviction-rate spike x120, batch-size growth observed. Possible prefetch/backpressure loop.
Alex M: I'm on it. Seeing a super high cache eviction rate, NTK-prefetch metrics look noisy.
Mira L: Confirmed — continuous-batching average batch_size jumped from 8 -> 64 in 30s and NTK prefixes count exploded. Traces show a lot of long-context requests hitting sliding-window path.
Jordan S: Which customers impacted? Any VIPs?
Sam R: Looks like three large tenants with long-context usage (legal-search-prod, docs-gen-big) are getting 5-10x token cost and elevated latency. Support already getting tickets.
Alex M: Dumping recent metrics clip:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] kv_evictions/s: 1240
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] continuous_batch_size.p95: 62
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] ntk_unique_prefixes/1m: 18k
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] p95_latency_ms: 980
```
Mira L: Root cause hypothesis: Rope sliding-window prefetch + NTK heuristic is creating many unique KV keys (high cardinality) which breaks our prefix caching assumptions, combined with continuous batching ramping up batch sizes causing memory pressure and further eviction -> cascade.
Jordan S: Priority and severity?
Alex M: Sev2 for customer impact (some customers facing timeouts), but cluster health trending toward Sev1 if we don't mitigate. Escalating to SRE lead.
Sam R: Mitigation ideas: 1) disable prefetch for rope sliding-window globally (fast) 2) cap continuous_batch_size to 16 via dynamic config (hotfix) 3) roll model routing to smaller context variant (fallback) 4) increase KV capacity (longer-term).
Tanya R: I can push a dynamic config to gate prefetch for rope-longctx. Quick command: `redwoodctl config set inference.continuous_batch.max_size=16 --cluster=us-west-2`
Alex M: Do it. Also flip prefetch to off for rope sliding-window path: `redwoodctl featureflag set rope.prefetch.enabled=false --scope=prod`
Mira L: Before flipping, can we confirm fallback is safe for the two big tenants? Some prompts rely on sliding-window semantics.
Sam R: Support: notify customers that we may briefly reduce longctx fidelity to stabilize. Draft msg: "We're throttling long-context prefetch to mitigate an infrastructure issue; you may see slightly higher latencies for large-context requests while we stabilize."
Jordan S: I applied the batch cap w/ config change and restarted the pool. rollout id: rcf-20260315-42. Patch log:
```
PATCH rcf-20260315-42 by Jordan S
- continuous_batch.max_size: 64 -> 16
- target: inference-rope-prod us-west-2 pool
status: rollout in-progress
```
ops-bot: Deploy event: rollout rcf-20260315-42 succeeded for 70% of nodes, remaining draining.
Mira L: After cap, batch p95 dropped to 18 within 40s, eviction rate down to ~120/s, p95 latency trending down to 220ms.
Alex M: I'm also toggling `rope.prefetch.enabled=false` now. ops-bot: featureflag change queued.
ops-bot: Feature flag rope.prefetch.enabled set to false in prod (us-west-2).
Sam R: Support update posted to customers in affected orgs.
Support Bot: Noted — customers: legal-search-prod (acct 1324), docs-gen-big (acct 2109), analytics-hub (acct 437). Incident channel created with tracking ticket INC-2026-4821.
Jordan S: We still see increased unique prefixes but the eviction rate is an order of magnitude lower. Looks like prefetch was the multiplier.
Mira L: Follow-up: we should roll a short-term hotfix that bounds NTK prefix expansion (ntk.max_prefixes=5000) for rope path and add signal to auto-gate prefetch under high-cardinality.
Alex M: Agreed. I'll open an ops PR with test plan and rollout steps. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/PR-4891
Sam R: Customer impact summary for postmortem: 3 customers saw 5-10x token processing and increased latency (timeouts for some requests). No data loss. Billed usage may spike; CS to coordinate credits.
Tanya R: Handoff: my shift ends in 30m. Next oncall @Jordan S, please take over the incident once we confirm steady state. Current state: prefetch disabled, batch cap applied, p95=180ms, kv_evictions=110/s.
Jordan S: Taking handoff. I'll keep watch and start the hotfix PR to add NTK guard. Assigning follow-up: SRE to add metric alert for ntk_unique_prefixes > 5k sustained for 2m. ENG-ML to review NTK heuristic.
Alex M: Postmortem actions: (1) hotfix ntk max_prefixes (2) add circuit-breaker on prefetch when eviction > 500/s (3) e2e test for long-context + sliding-window combos (4) CS communication template for spike credits.
Mira L: Also add a baseline regression test in staging that replays long docs from legal-search-prod to validate continuous batching stability.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4821 updated: status=stabilized, severity downgraded to S3, assignees=[Alex M, Jordan S, Tanya R], follow-ups added.
Jordan S: I'll be on pager for 2h to ensure no regression. If anything spikes, escalate to ENG-ML and oncall infra.
Sam R: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate customer credits and confirm support tickets are closed once we're green.
Alex M: Great job. We'll draft the postmortem and schedule a 30m RCA tomorrow.
Support Bot: Customers notified. Ticket INC-2026-4821 created and linked to support cases.
Jordan S: closing thread for now, monitoring. :white_check_mark:
